purpose: Teach: 西郷/母性/強まる/デリケート/青く/突っ込む/打ち込む/兼ね備え

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、地方の、本気で、絶対、西郷、絶対、地区の、絶対、医療体制、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、強化中です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Ren, the medical system in the rural Saigo area—we're actively strengthening our medical team there.
lines.style: Clear, steady delivery with quiet pride. Measured pace. The confidence of someone reporting on work that matters. No flourish, just fact-grounded warmth.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 母性、本気で、絶対、医療の重要性、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、認識されているんですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: So the importance of medical care is really being recognized by the team? That's encouraging, Doctor.
lines.style: Genuine curiosity underneath. Soft opening—he's asking rather than declaring. Lean slightly forward with the question. Respectful but not deferential.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。流行が、本気で、絶対、強まる、絶対、季節、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、警戒、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. As the epidemic season strengthens, our medical team remains vigilant and prepared.
lines.style: Steady, informative tone. Each phrase deliberate and grounded. Speaking from experience, not speculation. Slight nod on the affirmation—not rushed, not dramatic.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 患者さんの、本気で、絶対、デリケート、絶対、な状態、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、丁寧に、絶対、対応されているんですね、先生、本気for、感謝
lines.en: So the team handles patients in delicate conditions with real care and attention, then. That must take skill.
lines.style: Admiring, almost wondering. He's connecting the pieces aloud. Soft tone—recognizing the difficulty without overstating it. Genuine respect landing quietly.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。患者さんの顔色が、本気で、絶対、青く、絶対、なる際、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、迅速対応、絶対、いたしております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. When a patient's condition deteriorates—when their complexion changes—our team responds swiftly. That's non-negotiable.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. The word 'swiftly' carries weight—it's the threshold between routine and crisis. Precise diction. The voice of someone who has seen why speed matters.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 救急に、本気で、絶対、突っ込む、絶対、ような、絶対、車、絶対、貴院、絶対、対応、絶対、大変ですよね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: And managing emergency arrivals like that—vehicles rushing in—that's an enormous burden on your hospital.
lines.style: Acknowledging strain without pity. Thoughtful pause before speaking. The tone of someone recognizing difficulty in others. Slight hesitation—genuine concern, not flattery.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。医療研究に、本気で、絶対、打ち込む、絶対、若手医師、絶対、当院、絶対、育てております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We cultivate young physicians who are deeply committed to medical research. Building that foundation takes time and intention.
lines.style: Pride tempered with humility. Speaking of the work itself, not the institution. Warm but not sentimental. The tone of a mentor reflecting on what matters.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医師は、本気で、絶対、知識と人柄を、絶対、兼ね備えて、絶対、おられないと、絶対、いけないですよね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: A doctor has to carry both knowledge and character—they have to be whole people, don't they?
lines.style: Sincere observation, almost to himself. Slower pace. He's articulating something he's learned. Quiet respect in the delivery. Ends with genuine curiosity, not certainty.
